notes.title: 3 Days To Release!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_pPV1ydsQw0;full][/previewyoutube]

From the developers of Something's Wrong With Sunny Day Jack...

The Groom Of Gallagher Mansion, a supernatural romance visual novel, is releasing this Saturday, September 30, 2023! Explore an abandoned manor at the top of the hill to save your college club from losing funding!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2392230/ss_b82b0763d036e8231997fddee954f75b2f0a0a46.jpg?t=1695251998

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2392230/ss_0521de47bccfdc34cc53bdd53d8ae6652ee407fe.jpg?t=1695251998

What awaits you in the long-abandoned Gallagher estate, and is the dearly departed Elias Gallagher hiding something sinister behind those posh mannerisms? Or is he really only in it for the love of love?

Now's the perfect time to wishlist the game if you haven't already. We'll see you soon!
